summary_en: The company authorized acquisition of up to 300,000 shares (1.5% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of ¥900 million via ToSTNeT-3 on November 6, 2026, to enable flexible capital allocation.
title_en: Notice Regarding Decision on Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: On November 5, 2026, the board of directors of Sato Sho-ji Corporation resolved to acquire treasury shares under Article 156 of the Companies Act. The company will acquire up to 300,000 shares of its common stock, representing 1.45% of issued shares excluding treasury stock, for a maximum aggregate price of ¥900 million. The acquisition will be executed on November 6, 2026, through ToSTNeT-3 (off-market block trading on the Tokyo Stock Exchange). At the time of the announcement, the company held 1,071,087 treasury shares against 20,727,963 issued shares excluding treasury stock. The stated purpose is to enable flexible capital policy implementation in response to market conditions.
